text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both showing modest positive momentum with nearly flat 24-hour moves, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. BTC dominance holding steady at 60% indicates capital is neither fleeing to altcoins nor concentrating heavily in the leading asset, while the Fear & Greed index at 54 (Neutral) reflects a balanced market lacking strong directional bias. The $39B daily volume is moderate, consistent with a patient market waiting for clearer directional catalysts.
